name: 迪米特里·普朗雄
awards: 2026年 第50届安纳西国际动画电影节 长篇动画单元 另类竞赛大奖 (提名) 老尴这一家
name_full: 迪米特里·普朗雄 Dimitri Planchon
introduction: Dimitri Planchon is a comic books author whose works were published at Fluides Glaciales and l'Echo Des Savanes before being compiled in a comic book release: Jésus et les copains, followed by the three volumes of the Blaise series. He's also an illustrator for several newspapers such as "XXI", and his work was exhibited in Lausanne, Aix En Provence and more recently in Paris' Point Éphémère.
